title: Black screen, PC running
symptom: Screen is black but the computer fans are running
user_description: My screen just went black but I can hear the computer is still on!

options.text: Check the monitor power and cable
options.why: Fans running means the PC is on. A black screen usually means the monitor is off or the cable is loose. Always check physical connections first.
Far too drastic. Never start with the most destructive fix.
Might work by luck, but skips the real cause and wastes the user's time.

hints: What connects the PC to the screen?
real_world_tip: Check the monitor's own power light and button before touching the PC. It is the fastest check and often the whole fix.
